panel.commandcode.errorInvalidResponse: Could not read the Command Code response
panel.commandcode.errorInvalidResponseHint: The requests received responses, but their bodies could not be parsed. Check the host HTTP proxy or response decoding.
panel.commandcode.errorNetwork: Could not reach the Command Code service
panel.commandcode.errorNetworkHint: No request reached the server. Check your network connection or the API base setting.
panel.commandcode.errorServiceUnavailable: The Command Code service is temporarily unavailable
panel.commandcode.errorServiceUnavailableHint: The server returned errors (5xx). Try Refresh again in a moment.
panel.commandcode.noKeyHint: Paste a key — or sign in — under Settings → Command Code, then refresh.

settings.commandcode.accountActionLogin: Sign in for a new key
settings.commandcode.accountAddHint: Sign-in opens the Command Code authorization page and adds the account once you approve; you can also paste an API key.
settings.commandcode.accountAddLinkHint: If the sign-in page did not open automatically, use the link below.
settings.commandcode.accountCleanupPending: The account was removed, but credential cleanup is still pending. Retry without affecting other accounts.
settings.commandcode.accountClearKeyConfirm: Delete the default account's stored key? The provider then falls back to the environment or the official CLI sign-in.
settings.commandcode.accountModePinned: Mode: pinned to "{name}", still switching when it is unavailable
settings.commandcode.accountModelsHint: These models prefer this account and still switch when it is unavailable. A model belongs to one account; selecting it here moves it from any other.
settings.commandcode.accountNamePlaceholder: Name (optional; sign-in uses the account name)
settings.commandcode.accountNoKeyHint: No key yet: sign in through the browser, or paste an API key created in the commandcode.ai console.
settings.commandcode.accountOpFailed: The account change did not complete. Try again.
settings.commandcode.accountRemoveConfirm: Remove "{name}"? Its stored key and dedicated models are deleted with it.
settings.commandcode.accountsHint: Account actions apply immediately, no save needed. Add more accounts and requests switch to the next one when the current account hits its usage limit or its key stops working.
settings.commandcode.accountsRotationHint: Account actions apply immediately. When the current account hits its usage limit or its key stops working, requests switch to the next usable account in list order.
settings.commandcode.advancedInvalid: A number in Advanced settings is not ready to save; expand to fix it.
settings.commandcode.advancedSettingsHint: API base URL and network limits; usually leave as-is.
settings.commandcode.apiBaseHint: Defaults to https://api.commandcode.ai; usually leave as-is.
settings.commandcode.apiKeyHint: Create one in the commandcode.ai console. Saving with this field blank keeps the stored key.
settings.commandcode.apiKeyLocked: Key provided by a read-only source
settings.commandcode.cardRegistrationHint: This card is contributed by the Command Code plugin and is waiting for the settings page to finish assembling.
settings.commandcode.contextOverrideNoCatalog: The model catalog has not loaded yet; per-model overrides cannot be added right now.
settings.commandcode.contextOverridesHint: Set a context length for one model; it wins over the global value above. The picker lists only the models kept by the visible-models allowlist (the whole catalog while showing all).
settings.commandcode.contextWindowHint: Overrides the context window published by the model catalog, for every model without an override of its own below; the context meter and auto-compaction follow it. Empty follows the catalog. Shorthand like 32K or 1M is accepted.
settings.commandcode.contextWindowTooSmall: Context length must be at least 1
settings.commandcode.durationInvalid: Enter seconds with at most three decimal places
settings.commandcode.durationTooSmall: Must be at least 0.001 seconds (1 ms)
settings.commandcode.enrollmentBeginFailed: The account setup request failed. Check the connection and retry.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentCancelUnconfirmed: The cancel request was not confirmed. After reconnecting, check for unfinished records.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentCancelling: Waiting for the write to finish, then cleaning up
settings.commandcode.enrollmentCleanupPending: Cleanup is not finished. Please retry.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentCleanupRequestFailed: The cleanup request failed. Check the connection and retry.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentDisconnected: The setup connection dropped; the host is finishing up. After reconnecting, check for unfinished records.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentFailed: Account setup failed. No account was created.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentFailedCleaned: Setup failed; the temporary account was cleaned up.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentHostUnavailable: The host could not complete the account setup. Check the connection and write permissions.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentNameFailed: Signed in, but saving the name failed. Retry, or accept the existing name.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentNameRequestFailed: Saving the name failed. Retry, or accept the existing name.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentRecordCleanup: Account setup was not finished. Please retry.
settings.commandcode.enrollmentRecordNaming: Signed-in account waiting for its name to be confirmed
settings.commandcode.enrollmentStatusUnavailable: Setup status is unavailable; waiting to reconnect.
settings.commandcode.filterModelsByPlanHint: Show only models in your plan; on-demand credit accounts still see the full catalog.
settings.commandcode.intro: Account actions apply immediately; other settings are written by Save at the bottom. The API key stays in the local credential service and is never echoed.
settings.commandcode.loginDenied: Authorization was denied. Try again or paste the key manually.
settings.commandcode.loginFailedGeneric: Sign-in failed; try again or paste the key manually.
settings.commandcode.loginHintIdle: Alternatively, sign in to fetch and store a key automatically.
settings.commandcode.loginInvalidKey: The delivered key failed validation (401). Try again or paste it manually.
settings.commandcode.loginNetwork: Could not reach the Command Code service to validate the key; check your network and retry.
settings.commandcode.loginStoreFailed: The key could not be stored in the local credential service; paste it manually.
settings.commandcode.loginTimeout: Timed out waiting for the authorization callback; try again.
settings.commandcode.loginTitle: Sign in to fetch a key
settings.commandcode.loginUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable in this environment; paste the API key instead.
settings.commandcode.loginWaiting: Waiting for authorization in your browser. If the page did not open automatically, use the authorization link.
settings.commandcode.maxOutputTokensHint: Empty derives it from the model (default). A positive number never exceeds the model ceiling or the gateway’s 131,072. 0 omits the field (CLI and OpenAI only; Claude’s Messages endpoint requires it). 64K shorthand accepted.
settings.commandcode.maxOutputTokensInvalid: Enter 0 or a valid whole-token count
settings.commandcode.maxOutputTokensTooLarge: Output limit must not exceed 131,072 (the gateway cap)
settings.commandcode.maxOutputTokensTooSmall: Output limit must be at least 0 (0 omits the field)
settings.commandcode.modelAllowanceTitle: Monthly usage this model can draw, in USD. Every model shares one monthly pool — this is not extra credit on top of the plan.
settings.commandcode.modelCatalogFailed: The model catalog could not be loaded; saved settings still apply.
settings.commandcode.modelsInvalid: A number in Models & context is not ready to save; expand to fix it.
settings.commandcode.offloadSeenImagesForCacheHint: CLI transport only. After this model responds to an image, durably replace older pixels with text to avoid cache rollback when another image arrives. To inspect an old image again, the model must reread its file or the user must attach it again. Off by default.
settings.commandcode.openAnalytics: View model usage, cost and performance
settings.commandcode.requestTimeoutMsHint: Time to wait for the first response byte; default 300 s (the official CLI’s). The Provider API route withholds headers until the upstream model emits its first token, so a slow upstream can still outlast the default; raise it when a timeout message suggests it.
settings.commandcode.saveInvalid: Fix the highlighted field before saving
settings.commandcode.showSidebarQuota: Show the quota card in the sidebar
settings.commandcode.showSidebarQuotaHint: Show a plan and quota card at the bottom of the sidebar that opens the full dashboard. Off by default; while off, no background usage refresh runs for it.
settings.commandcode.streamIdleTimeoutMsHint: How long a stalled stream is treated as dead; default 300 s (deliberately generous — long-thinking models can stay silent for minutes).
settings.commandcode.title: Command Code
settings.commandcode.transportMaxRetriesHint: How many times a failed connection is retried automatically; default 5 (waits of 0.5+1+2+4+8s, ~15s in total). After that the failure is reported instead of waiting on the exponential backoff. 0 disables the retries. Rate limits and 5xx answers keep their own, longer retry window.
settings.commandcode.updateHint: A newer version has been published; click for release notes. The notice disappears once the plugin is updated.
settings.commandcode.usageInvalidResponse: Could not read the Command Code response
settings.commandcode.usageInvalidResponseHint: The requests received responses, but their bodies could not be parsed. Check the host HTTP proxy or response decoding.
settings.commandcode.usageKeyInvalidHint: The server rejects every request (401). Check the key configured for this account, or generate a new one in the commandcode.ai console.
settings.commandcode.usageNetworkError: Could not reach the Command Code service
settings.commandcode.usageNetworkHint: No request reached the server. Check your network connection or the API base setting.
settings.commandcode.usagePeriodUnknown: 官方用量汇总，统计周期未确认
settings.commandcode.usageServiceUnavailable: The Command Code service is temporarily unavailable
settings.commandcode.usageServiceUnavailableHint: The server returned errors (5xx); try Refresh again later.
settings.commandcode.usageUnconfigured: No API key configured for this account yet.
settings.commandcode.visibleModelsHint: Check the models you want to keep, and model pickers will list only those. If nothing is checked, every model is shown. After saving, the change applies in both web and terminal settings. This page shows their effective selection; plan access is filtered separately.
settings.commandcode.visibleModelsStaleHint: {count} selected model(s) are no longer in the catalog (possibly retired); other models are unaffected. Clean them up or keep them.
settings.commandcode.webSearch: Serve dsh web search with Command Code
settings.commandcode.webSearchHint: Use the same key for dsh web search; turning it off restores the previous backend.
settings.commandcode.writeCleanupPending: 账号修改已确认，清理记录尚未收束，请重试清理。
settings.commandcode.writeClosed: 客户端已销毁，未发出的操作已停止；已确认的修改保留。
settings.commandcode.writeConfigUnconfirmed: 配置提交未获确认；密钥未写入，请核对宿主状态后重试。
settings.commandcode.writeConflict: 待提交字段已被其他操作修改，配置未写入；请核对后再保存。
settings.commandcode.writeKeyConfirmed: 原引用的密钥操作已获确认。
settings.commandcode.writeKeyNotIssued: 密钥操作尚未发出；请核对后重试。
settings.commandcode.writeKeyUnconfirmed: 密钥操作未获确认；请核对后手动重试。
settings.commandcode.writeRefreshFailed: 密钥状态刷新失败；已获确认的写入仍有效。
settings.commandcode.writeTargetAfter: 原引用的密钥操作已发出，默认引用随后变化；请核对两个引用。
settings.commandcode.writeTargetBefore: 默认密钥引用已变化，本次密钥操作未发出；请核对当前目标。
settings.commandcode.zdrHint: Use only upstreams that retain no data and do not train on requests; availability and pricing may differ.
